integrity: The universal identities are proved from Schur orthogonality, the fixed-point character, and the Cameron-Cohen derangement theorem. The bundled finite verifier is corroborative only. The date is the verified publication day of the earliest day-resolved primary source materially used in the proof comparison.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the standard irreducible constituent of a finite doubly transitive permutation action and to endpoint norms. It does not address higher-rank permutation actions, arbitrary irreducibles, intermediate ell-p norms, or infinite groups.
title: Derangement density controls the standard Fourier block of every doubly transitive action
